description: This file defines the MiniLangElement class, a superclass for all XML element models in the Mini-language processing framework within the OFBiz project. It includes methods for handling XML elements, logging, and artifact info gathering.

classes.name: MiniLangElement
classes.description: Superclass for all XML element models in the Mini-language framework, providing common functionality for handling XML elements, logging, and artifact info.

methods.name: MiniLangElement
methods.description: Constructor initializing the element with an XML Element and a SimpleMethod.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Updates artifact info context with this element's data (empty implementation).

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the source code line number or 'unknown' if not available.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the tag name of the XML element.

methods.name: outputTraceMessage
methods.description: Logs a trace message with context information.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the XML element as '<tagName>'.
